p: Museu de Arte Contemporânea da Universidade de São Paulo

A park popular for sports and outdoor activities such as cycling and skating, and a solid choice for a picnic. The park also hosts a giant wheel, the largest in South America. Not a lot of foliage besides grass, though.
4777 Avenida das Nações Unidas, Alto de Pinheiros, São Paulo, 05477-902

The 176,000-m² in the middle of the campus contains gardens that replicate the 6 ecosystems from the state of São Paulo, totaling 180 species of plants. The 50-m-tall tower is the Torre do Relógio, its 12 panels represent the 12 areas…
216 Avenida Kenkiti Simomoto, Jaguaré, São Paulo, 05347-010
100 Avenida Gonçalo Madeira, jaguaré, São Paulo
500 Avenida José César de Oliveira, São Paulo, 05317-000
37 Avenida Engenheiro Billings, Jaguaré, São Paulo, 05321-010
Previously the Museu da Arte Contemporânea (which is now at the city's South Central), this museum houses works by the Art students in the university.
